title: The Dopup module provides functionality for selecting and working with Webforms. (CVE-2026-114530)
description: The Dopup module for Drupal provides functionality for selecting and working with Webforms. A vulnerability exists due to insufficient entity access checking in some cases, which may lead to exposure of the titles of private Webforms. This issue affects versions prior to 1.0.7. A patch is available to address this vulnerability.
aiSummary: The Dopup module, which facilitates selection and interaction with Webforms in Drupal, contains an access control flaw. Specifically, it does not adequately verify entity access permissions in certain scenarios, potentially allowing unauthorized users to view the titles of Webforms that are intended to be private. This information disclosure vulnerability affects all versions before 1.0.7. The vendor has released a patch to fix this issue.
aiImpact: The vulnerability may result in unauthorized disclosure of private Webform titles. While this does not expose the full content of the Webforms, it could reveal sensitive metadata that was intended to remain confidential. There are no known exploits in the wild at this time.
